fleet_readiness.interpretation: Retained stale/offline records do not by themselves degrade the protected server host; fleet counts and protected-host readiness remain separate signals.

limitations.description: PhotoPrism is the currently cataloged runtime app; cross-app coverage grows from the same contract.
limitations.label: Apps

limitations.description: Application-owned media indexing is not a Pocket Lab parity authority.
limitations.label: Apps

limitations.description: Restore apply and update apply remain unavailable unless separately implemented and validated.
limitations.label: Apps

limitations.description: Heartbeat freshness can move during capture; comparison records the observed revision.
limitations.label: Devices

limitations.description: Per-device profile fields remain partial when the agent has not published them.
limitations.label: Devices

limitations.description: Healthy online devices are not removed without explicit confirmation.
limitations.label: Devices

limitations.description: CPU, memory, and storage presentation may be rounded or unit-formatted.
limitations.label: Home

limitations.description: Live runtime semantic evidence remains explicit and release-bound.
limitations.label: Home

limitations.description: Home never executes system operations directly.
limitations.label: Home

limitations.description: Credential values are never observable parity fields.
limitations.label: Identity

limitations.description: Identity guard and protected server-host authority fields are planned and may remain unavailable until identity bootstrap services are implemented.
limitations.label: Identity

limitations.description: The current tab is direct-rendered and has no dedicated selector layer.
limitations.label: Identity

limitations.description: Identity guard and protected server-host projections are not fully implemented.
limitations.label: Identity

limitations.description: Identity mismatch repair/rejoin must remain explicit and fail closed.
limitations.label: Identity

limitations.description: Status labels intentionally use Lite-friendly wording instead of raw backend enums.
limitations.label: Backup & Restore

limitations.description: App restore apply remains explicitly unsupported where the repository reports it unavailable.
limitations.label: Backup & Restore

limitations.description: Historical restore previews are evidence only and never authorize a new restore.
limitations.label: Backup & Restore

limitations.description: Live Termux and live browser semantic capture remain explicit; missing capture is not drift.
limitations.label: Backup & Restore

limitations.description: Unsafe writes remain disabled while the recovery projection is stale.
limitations.label: Backup & Restore

limitations.description: The current product contract is a protection-mode policy surface, not a general arbitrary rule engine.
limitations.label: Rules

limitations.description: Per-rule identity and execution history are planned, not present in the current API.
limitations.label: Rules

limitations.description: Planned trigger/condition/action automation is not marked verified.
limitations.label: Rules

limitations.description: Raw scanner output and sensitive paths are intentionally excluded.
limitations.label: Security

limitations.description: A missing scanner is runtime-unavailable, not semantic drift.
limitations.label: Security

limitations.description: The browser never runs Lynis, Trivy, shell, PM2, or NATS commands.
limitations.label: Security
